name: 94518 · Concord, CA
findings: ZIP 94518 (Concord) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94518 (Concord) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
